entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Google Page Creator was a website creation and hosting service by Google launched in beta in 2006. It was a tool for basic website design, requiring no HTML or CSS knowledge. Users just had to login to their Gmail account and got 100MB of hosting space and a Gmail-derived domain name and the service was completely free.
